aboutParagraphs: Nevin Park's Nightmare layout is exactly what the name promises — a long, almost completely wooded test that has become a proving ground for Charlotte's tournament players. From the red tees it plays 7,401 feet at par 64, with tight fairways, water on three holes, and no room for loose shots.

Free to play with concrete tees and DISCatcher baskets, the Nightmare is the serious half of Nevin Park — the shorter Daydream layout shares the property for players who want a gentler round. There's a practice basket on site for warming up.
This is the course that separates Charlotte's weekend players from its competitors: accuracy, distance, and nerve, in that order.

signatureHoleDescription: Hole 18 closes the Nightmare with 540 feet of par 4 and water in play — a fitting final exam for a course built on tight fairways and nerve. From the tee you're committing to a line through the woods; from the landing zone you're throwing at a green the water guards. It's the hole that decides whether you survived the Nightmare or it survived you.
localTips: Bring your A game — 7,400 feet of tight, wooded golf with water on three holes. The shorter Daydream layout is right there if you want a gentler round. Free to play, practice basket on site, and give yourself time: this one earns every stroke.
